inputs.checklistItemText: Existing and proposed behind-the-curb improvements not shown (GRD-02)
inputs.question: Are existing and proposed behind-the-curb improvements shown on this grading plan? Behind-the-curb improvements include sidewalks, landscape strips, trees, lighting, ramps, and other features between the curb and the property line. Look for both existing conditions and proposed improvements in these areas.

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a presence/feature-identification question—whether behind-the-curb improvements appear on the plan at all—rather than asking to measure, dimension, or inspect drawing annotations. This is a sheet-discovery and feature-presence check, not a measurement or drawing-element inspection.
